dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Good morning. Please sit down. So — what seems to be the problem?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've been feeling really tired for the past two weeks. Not just normal tired — I can't seem to shake it.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: I see. Are you sleeping well?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Not really. I've been going to bed quite late — around 2 or 3 a.m. And I have to be up by 8.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: So you're getting around five hours of sleep. That's quite low. Any other symptoms?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I've had some headaches. And I've been finding it hard to concentrate in lectures.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Not really. I often skip breakfast. And lunch is usually just something from the vending machine.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: That would explain some of the fatigue and headaches. You shouldn't skip meals — your brain needs fuel. How much water are you drinking?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: You should drink at least two litres of water a day. Coffee is a diuretic — it actually dehydrates you. Are you exercising at all?

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: I used to. But since the semester got busy, I've stopped.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: You don't have to do intense training. Even a twenty-minute walk helps. I'd strongly recommend getting back into some form of movement.

dialogue.speaker: Rustam
dialogue.text: Do I need any tests or medication?

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: I don't think so at this stage. Your symptoms are consistent with sleep deprivation and poor nutrition. But if things don't improve in two weeks, come back and we'll do a blood test.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: A general multivitamin wouldn't hurt. But you shouldn't rely on supplements — they don't replace a proper diet. Focus on food first.

dialogue.speaker: Doctor
dialogue.text: Take care of yourself. Sleep is medicine. Food is medicine. Start there.
